rules.logic: XQL(ASM-004 Web Technology Fingerprint And CMS Enumeration Findings) AND (XQL(ASM-004 Content-Discovery Path Fan-Out 1 Src To Many URIs) OR XQL(ASM-004 Web Vulnerability-Scan Threat-Signature Burst)) AND (BIOC(ASM-004 SQL-Injection Probe Pattern In Web Request) OR BIOC(ASM-004 OS-Command-Injection Probe Pattern In Web Request) OR XQL(ASM-004 Injection-Probe Threat Signatures Against Banking App)) — stitches the static ASM web-surface discovery with the live NGFW content-discovery + vulnerability-scan + injection-probe detections into one exposure-management incident.
rules.name: Exposure Management — Exposed Web Surface Discovered + Actively Enumerated + Injection-Probed
